execution_owner: GPT-6 Sol max; one implementation/synthesis owner only

execution.monitor_placement: Independent wrapper and evidence under this result directory; do not alter tagged production source/script/config.

frozen_inputs.verification_required: Execution owner must retain the fresh input_hashes.sha256 and compare actual synthesis inputs against the prior final run; generated config differences are permitted only for run-specific paths, with semantic options unchanged.

host_snapshot.other_workloads: Other users Vivado jobs present per controller observation; never signal or change them.

resource_budget.trigger: MemAvailable <= 64 GiB OR sum of RSS for this task process tree >= 380 GiB, whichever occurs first.
resource_budget.RSS_accounting: Sum of owned processes VmRSS is a conservative guard and may double-count shared pages; retain per-process RSS and largest-process peak as well.
resource_budget.interpretation: Host headroom is shared and can change. The 380 GiB cap is not reserved capacity or a guarantee that synthesis will complete. The global available-memory guard may trigger sooner.
resource_budget.protection_limit: Periodic user-space monitoring reduces risk but cannot guarantee against an allocation spike or independent host pressure between samples.

guard_execution_requirements: Start the task in its own verified session/process group; keep the monitor outside the group and active for the entire synthesis.
Track descendants together with PID starttime to avoid PID reuse errors and cover any child-created groups; never use process-name or user-wide kill commands.
Retain a durable 2-second log with UTC, MemAvailable, tree RSS, process count, largest process RSS, and peak statistics.

At a threshold or monitor failure, freeze only the verified task group/tree with SIGSTOP before taking a bounded snapshot; terminate only those owned tasks with SIGKILL after capture. A stopped process cannot promptly handle SIGTERM without being resumed.
Record the exact trigger, measured limits, owned PID/PGID/session identities, command, stage/log tail and exit status; do not kill or renice other users processes.
Do not impose a fixed runtime timeout. Distinguish success, tool-reported failure, operator/user stop, and memory-guard termination.
Apply and verify nice 19 and the four-CPU task affinity before launching the compiler; apply ionice idle when supported and explicitly record any unsupported status.
Use the new 64 GiB / 380 GiB limits throughout; the superseded 32 GiB / 400 GiB proposal is not approved for this run.
If protected headroom is already below the new floor before launch, do not launch the task. Preserve evidence without interfering with unrelated processes.
completion_evidence: Capture actual command, tool version, input identities, full synthesis diagnostics, monitored peaks and final process exit.
If successful, independently verify complete-top csynth report and generated RTL exist and correspond to this run; inspect real resource/interface/latency results.
HLS completion/generated RTL alone do not establish RTL cosimulation, Vivado physical synthesis/implementation timing, U55C platform link or board success.

resource_priority.cpu_affinity: Restrict the task to four logical CPUs selected from its existing allowed CPU affinity; never alter affinity of other work.
resource_priority.scope: Controls host execution only; no production HLS options, architecture or source changes.
resource_priority.concurrency: Exactly one complete-top synthesis; no parallel exploratory runs.
resource_priority.must_verify: Log actual task PID affinity, nice and I/O priority, plus tool child inheritance; environment limits do not by themselves guarantee proprietary-tool thread count.

review_updates.reason: User explicitly required that other projects be protected.
